profile.name: Mohamed Rayan S P
profile.intro: I don't just build systems. I obsess over them until I understand every layer, edge case and architectural trade-off. :)
notes: My journey into AI Engineering wasn't a neat, linear path.
I immersed myself in Data Science and ML theory, waded through the noise, and spent time dissecting how complex models and pipelines operate behind the scenes.
That perfectionism is what drives me today.

I specialize in building production-grade enterprise solutions for retail and supply chain across AWS and GCP, obsessing over the details in multi-agent systems, advanced RAG, and cloud-native automation until they run with bulletproof reliability.
I believe in high-impact, pragmatic engineering: designing intelligent systems strictly where they eliminate operational bottlenecks and deliver measurable value, built right down to the iron.
